about: The schedule's PR 15a (to-dos/gc-mode/mockups/schedule-pr15.md, call 4; #5368, v2.5198): customerScheduleLetter, which the schedule's 1b left on the spike until Owner Billing's O2 put lateFinish on main (schedule-pr1b.lift.json's stays), placed by hand at the end of schedule/customerScheduleSend.ts with one fix: a customer row with no contact's name is greeted 'Hello,' and the letter goes to the company alone.
